name: Murder at Mystic High
source:
"Murder at Mystic High" is a visual novel murder mystery game where you play as a human detective. It is your job to figure out which suspect murdered the victim, Wyatt Nive, at his school. The catch? He was a ghost, and so are the suspects. So not only do you need to solve the murder, but you need to learn more about the supernatural world you had no idea existed until today.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440810/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Murder at Mystic High》是一款謀殺推理視覺小說，你將扮演人類偵探。受害者懷亞特．奈夫在學校遇害，你的工作就是找出哪位嫌疑人是兇手。難題在於：他是幽靈，嫌疑人們也一樣。因此，你不僅要破解謀殺案，還得了解一個直到今天，才知道其存在的超自然世界。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440810/]Steam[/url]]
